notes: SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.gpg were downloaded directly from releases.ubuntu.com on 2026-09-07 during S7.0 research (raw curl, not summarized through any intermediate tool). The signing key was fetched by exact fingerprint from keyserver.ubuntu.com and `gpg --verify SHA256SUMS.gpg SHA256SUMS` reported a Good signature from that key - so the pinned `sha256` value above is proven authentic/untampered from Canonical's own publication chain, not guessed. That is NOT the same claim as `verified: true`: the actual 6.0 GB ISO itself has never been downloaded or hashed in this environment, so `verified` stays false and `verified_at` stays null until `verify-base-image.sh` (or `serein.distribution.base.verify_base_image`) actually runs against the real downloaded file - see docs/distribution/known-limitations.md and docs/distribution/security.md for the exact trust-chain evidence.
